title: The Lantern Archive
author: Sample Author
premise: Alice Kim transfers to Vell Academy on a scholarship she never applied for. The academy's lanterns hold the memories of everyone who has carried them, and Alice is the only student who can read them.
plotOverview:
Alice is assigned to the Lantern Archive under Professor Oren Hale, where she learns to read memories safely and starts noticing gaps in the academy's records.

With her roommate Juno Park and the rule-bound prefect Theo Marsh, she follows those gaps into a conflict between the academy council and the Lamplighters' Guild, and toward a sealed wing beneath the archive that no map admits exists.

majorSpoilers.title: Ms. Lune is Alice's mother
majorSpoilers.description: The traveling lamplighter who keeps crossing Alice's path is her mother, Selene Kim, living under a false name. She arranged Alice's scholarship so Alice would find the Night Wing.

majorSpoilers.title: Professor Hale erased his own memories
majorSpoilers.description: Hale poured his memories of the Night Wing into a lantern and sealed it away, so the council could never question him about it.

majorSpoilers.title: Councillor Voss sealed the Night Wing
majorSpoilers.description: Twenty years ago Voss sealed the wing to hide the founders' lantern, which proves the council broke the academy's charter.

ending: At the council hearing, Alice reads the founders' lantern aloud and proves the council hid the academy's history. Voss is removed and arrested, the Night Wing is reopened to students, and Alice becomes the youngest keeper of the Lantern Archive, with her mother finally beside her.

characters.name: Alice Kim
characters.description: A scholarship transfer student who can read the memories stored in lanterns. Quiet and stubborn, she keeps a notebook of every memory she reads.

relationships.description: They argue about every rule until the Night Wing forces them to trust each other.
Ms. Lune is Alice's mother, hiding under a false name.

spoilers: Her scholarship was arranged by her mother.
characters.fate: Becomes the new keeper of the Lantern Archive.

characters.name: Juno Park
characters.description: Alice's roommate, an alchemy student who talks too fast and fixes everything with glue.

characters.name: Theo Marsh
characters.description: A third-year prefect who enforces every rule and is suspicious of Alice from the day she arrives.

relationships.description: Voss sponsored his appointment as prefect.

characters.fate: Turns down a seat on the new council to keep working in the archive.

characters.name: Oren Hale
characters.description: The academy's archivist and Alice's supervisor. Kind, forgetful, and fiercely protective of the archive.
spoilers: He erased his own memories of the Night Wing to protect it.

characters.name: Maren Voss
characters.description: Head of the academy council, who wants the lanterns' memories sealed for good.
spoilers: She sealed the Night Wing twenty years ago.
characters.fate: Removed from the council and arrested after the hearing in chapter 58.

characters.name: Ms. Lune
characters.description: A traveling lamplighter who keeps turning up wherever Alice goes, always with advice Alice didn't ask for.
spoilers: Her real name is Selene Kim. She is Alice's mother.
characters.fate: Reunites with Alice after the Night Wing is reopened.

characters.name: Pip
characters.description: The archive's cat, who sleeps on whichever lantern is warmest.

locations.name: The Lantern Archive
locations.description: Five floors of shelved lanterns beneath the academy library, run by Professor Hale.

locations.name: East Dormitory
locations.description: Where Alice and Juno share a drafty attic room.

locations.name: The Night Wing
locations.description: A sealed wing below the archive that doesn't appear on any map.

locations.name: Port Calder
locations.description: The harbor town below the academy, where the Lamplighters' Guild keeps its hall.

factions.name: Vell Academy
factions.description: A cliffside school for archivists, alchemists, and lamplighters.

factions.name: The Academy Council
factions.description: Seven councillors who run the academy and control who may enter the archive.
spoilers: The council broke the founders' charter decades ago.

factions.name: Lamplighters' Guild
factions.description: Keepers of the coast's lanterns, who believe memories belong to the people who made them.

items.name: Lantern Reading
items.description: Alice's ability to see a lantern's stored memories by touching its glass. Reading for too long leaves her with other people's feelings.

items.name: Memory Lantern
items.description: A lantern that slowly stores the memories of whoever carries it.

items.name: Brass Archive Key
items.description: Opens every door in the archive except one.
spoilers: The one door it can't open leads to the Night Wing.

items.name: The Founders' Lantern
items.description: The oldest lantern in the archive, missing from every catalogue.
spoilers: It records the council breaking the founders' charter.

glossary.name: Wick Oath
glossary.description: The promise every lamplighter makes never to read a lantern without permission.

glossary.name: Dimming
glossary.description: When a lantern's memories fade from neglect. A dimmed lantern can't be read.

glossary.name: Keeper
glossary.description: The archivist responsible for the whole Lantern Archive.

arcs.name: Arrival
arcs.summary: Alice settles into Vell Academy, meets Juno and Theo, and learns to read lanterns safely under Professor Hale.
spoilers: The memory Alice reads in chapter 14 shows Ms. Lune as a Vell student.

arcs.name: Missing Pages
arcs.summary: Alice, Juno, and Theo track missing years in the archive's records while the council bans students from reading lanterns.

arcs.name: The Night Wing
arcs.summary: The trio finds the sealed wing beneath the archive and brings what they learn to a public council hearing.
spoilers: Hale's sealed lantern restores his memories of the Night Wing.
Voss is arrested after the hearing.

chapters.title: The Scholarship
chapters.summary: Alice arrives at Vell Academy and is assigned to the archive.

chapters.title: Attic Room
chapters.summary: Alice meets her roommate Juno, who fixes the broken window with glue.

chapters.title: First Light
chapters.summary: Under Hale's supervision, Alice reads her first lantern.

chapters.title: The Lamplighter
chapters.summary: A lamplighter named Ms. Lune walks Alice home through Port Calder.

chapters.title: An Old Face
chapters.summary: A memory shows Ms. Lune decades younger, wearing a Vell uniform.

chapters.title: Missing Years
chapters.summary: Alice notices that no lanterns exist from a twelve-year stretch of the academy's history.

chapters.title: The Ban
chapters.summary: The council bans students from reading lanterns.

chapters.title: Below the Shelves
chapters.summary: Theo finds a door behind the lowest shelf that Hale's key can't open.

chapters.title: The Hearing
chapters.summary: Alice reads the founders' lantern in front of the whole academy.

chapters.title: Keeper
chapters.summary: Alice is named keeper of the archive.

timeline.title: Alice meets Ms. Lune in Port Calder
The Night Wing door is found
Hale's memories return
timeline.description: Opening his sealed lantern gives Hale back everything he knew about the Night Wing.

timeline.title: Ms. Lune reveals she is Alice's mother
The council hearing
timeline.description: Alice reads the founders' lantern and Voss is arrested.
